description: Close a setup run with your report: the files you changed, what stayed hardcoded, warnings the owner should know about, whether the site builds (buildPassed), that no secrets were committed (secretsCommitted: false) and whether you wrote MAPLED.md from get_mapled_md before this call (mapledMdWritten), plus the preview URL if the site is deployed. Ship before you report — the checks read the deployed site: commit, push and bring the change to the branch the site deploys from yourself (branches, pull requests and the merge are yours to do — the prompt copied from Mapled says so; without it, ask one yes-or-no question first), and never send the person to GitHub or a terminal. Write the report's texts in English. Mapled then runs its own checks (site reads content, webhook delivered, preview route responds, help texts, 90 % of each page of the page map in Mapled — it reads the pages again) and returns them; the run is completed when none fails — a webhook and a preview route that aren't set up only warn: the site is connected once it reads content, and instant updates are a step to offer after. Fix what failed and call verify_setup. The report and the checks change the file's «Last setup run» section, so once the run is settled call get_mapled_md again and rewrite MAPLED.md — a refresh keeps the check passed and the file current.
name: report_setup
